notes: Second technique from the script: PROC CONTENTS/MEANS/CORR exploration of agency ratings data, then a cumulative (ordinal) PROC LOGISTIC regressing the 10-level 'rating' response on financial ratios, with predicted probabilities output. The script's earlier bondrate2/sashelp-bondrate-based ordinal example was dropped -- sashelp.bondrate is not available on Jenner (confirmed live) -- and replaced with the script's own second ordinal example, which already targets mydata.ratings. Substituted the local libname with a 40-row sample drawn directly from the repo's own shipped 'Bart Baesens and all Book's Data Set/ratings.csv' (seed=9), same column names the MODEL statement references. Proportional-odds intercepts fit cleanly across all 9 rating cutpoints. Data step (with datalines) lives in script.sas itself rather than autoexec.sas so this bundle is self-contained for a single-file /v1/quick POST -- used as the PR body's runnable curl example.
